fields.summary: Autonomous plan run 01M77N81 for bug 01M77N83 (watchdog: PR green at 52ace47 and unmerged after step land-triage failed). The planner traced run 01M77DWNRDSFY0PEP0S1P58P5W (change set 01M763Z4, PR #480): rhiza ship land was refused with a model conflict. The change set's op 01M764M3 updates ship-check-ci-test-findings' statement on base 01M6MC4GXTJ7SWF8NV4VMZDJ9N, which is stale because change set 01M76B50 (landed via #455) has since rewritten field:statement in op 01M76MENT. rhiza check only warns on an in-flight change set's conflict, so build/check, the pre-push check and CI all passed. land-triage runs `rhiza ship gate --failed`, which passes only for a recorded gate or pre-push failure, so the run ended (and the watchdog's two retries of land-triage repeated the same deterministic failure). The planner asked how ship-change should handle it, recommending a model-conflict fixer step. No owner answers in an autonomous run, so the arbiter decided (Decision ship-land-model-conflict-repair): land reports a model conflict distinctly, land-triage routes it to a model-conflict fixer that restates each conflicting update on the landed version with --rebase and commits it, and the run goes back through the gate and land within max_visits. Earlier, the pre-land gate and rhiza ship check fail on a conflict in the shipping change set's own ops; other in-flight conflicts stay warnings. The planner notes the CLI spells the rebase as `rhiza set <ref> --rebase` (buildUpdate in internal/api/write_node.go). The serves link goes to m4-runs-hold-up, as for the earlier ship-change bug fixes.
fields.title: Plan: ship-change repairs a land refused on a model conflict (autonomous)

fields.statement: Two accepted change sets plan contradictory fixes for a land refused on a model conflict: this one (01M77N83, Decision ship-land-model-conflict-repair: land reports the conflict, land-triage routes to a model-conflict fixer that runs `rhiza set --rebase`, and the gate and rhiza ship check --model-conflict fail on the shipping change set's own conflicts) and 01M77N1G (Decision ship-land-model-conflict-rebase, leaves ship-land-records-model-conflict and ship-change-model-conflict-fix-step: steps land-conflict-triage and model-conflict-fix -> gate-land, a Model-Conflict: trailer, a 3-fix count in ship check --model-conflict, land max_visits 4, gate-land 9). Only one design can ship; the other's capabilities would no longer match the code. Ship-land-model-conflict-repair is meant to supersede ship-land-model-conflict-rebase, a link the model cannot record while 01M77N1G is unlanded. Should 01M77N1G be retired (withdrawn) in favour of this change set, or this one in favour of it?

ops.note: The question asks which of two contradictory designs for a land refused on a model conflict ships; this Decision is one of them.

Both plan the fix for a land refused on a model conflict with contradictory designs (Decision ship-land-model-conflict-repair here, ship-land-model-conflict-rebase there); this one's Decision supersedes the other's, and only one may ship (question ship-land-model-conflict-two-designs).
